description: This file contains ARM64 NEON assembly code implementing specialized kernel routines for quantized sparse matrix multiplication (Q8 GEMM) optimized for 8x8 block operations. It includes macros for instruction separation, functions for transposing 4x4 data blocks, and multiple kernel implementations for different data widths and quantization parameter configurations aimed at high-performance sparse matrix computations in deep learning frameworks.
